title: The Rules Enabling Act
summary: The Rules Enabling Act authorizes general federal rules of practice and procedure while limiting their effect on substantive rights. It supplies a validity inquiry for Federal Rules distinct from the ordinary Erie choice when no such Rule governs.
notes: Shady Grove contains divided reasoning about how the Act applies to state rights. Preserve the plurality, concurrence, and dissent rather than presenting one broad formulation as unanimous.

sections.Meaning: The Rules Enabling Act authorizes general federal rules of practice and procedure while limiting their effect on substantive rights. It supplies a validity inquiry for Federal Rules distinct from the ordinary Erie choice when no such Rule governs.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the applicable Federal Rule, its operation, and the alleged effect on substantive rights. Read Sibbach, Hanna, and the separate approaches in Shady Grove. Distinguish this statutory limit from Congress’s constitutional authority to enact a procedural statute.
